title: Kissed Smoky Jamaican Shrimp Noodles
description: A low-calorie, smoky Jamaican dish featuring flat rice noodles, lacquer-glaze, and shrimp, served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, brown sugar, soy sauce, lime juice, and olive oil.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the chopped scallions to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet, tossing to combine with the shrimp and scallions.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the noodle mixture in a Korean brass bowl and garnish with additional scallions if desired.
